statement: Dissector's feature command enumeration (not HID report IDs) lists mapping get/clear/set 0x80-0x82, attributes 0x83-0x84, default mappings 0x85, reset 0x86, settings set/clear/get 0x87-0x89, setting label/max/default 0x8a-0x8c, mode/default-settings 0x8d-0x8e, pulse 0x8f and potentially destructive bootloader/off commands 0x90/0x9f. Dissector lines 3-43,518-555,812-832. This is broader than inspected wired kernel/SDL actual requests, and field names/side effects are NOT verified against an authentic 1302. Do not send reset/bootloader/shutdown or unknown GETs as a result of this lead. Capture gate: Plan Session 1 capture host-originated feature1 commands and replies and Session 3 optional passive Steam trace; follow-up feature-command matrix requires separate explicitly authorized device-safe test design. Source range is a hypothesis from iczero at 83c46d7, shared lineage 'sc2' with the previously imported sc2 README/dissector/haptics sources. No independent cross-source confirmation and no physical wired experiment.
